fact: The Ministry of Finance, Budget and Digital Economy opened a workshop on the AI landscape on 25 November 2025 with UNDP, whose conclusions are to feed the strategic roadmap for AI development in Burundi (a roadmap being prepared, no strategy yet adopted).
title: Ouverture officielle de l'atelier sur l'évaluation du paysage de l'intelligence artificielle au Burundi
publisher: Ministère des Finances, du Budget et de l'Economie Numérique
